## v0.1.9

- Add movie and series requests, admin review, Emby sync matching, and user availability notices.
- Email administrators about new requests using configurable SMTP with mandatory STARTTLS.
- Allow users to start a separate download for every episode in a selected season.
- Show the installed release version and flag when GitHub has a newer release.
- Store settings, catalog snapshots, and requests directly in the mounted `/data` directory; document migration from `.vloader`.
- Add a horizontal settings section menu and tighten the sidebar layout.
- Preserve notification settings when saving connection or OIDC settings; keep SMTP passwords out of settings responses.
